title: Road trip to Song-Kol
desc: You leave Bishkek and start with the Burana Tower and its old archaeological grounds, then sit down with a Dungan family for a homemade lagman lunch, a warm window into one of the country's many cultures.

The road carries on through Kochkor and up over the Kalmak-Ashuu Pass at 3400 m, with mountains opening on every side, before dropping to Song-Kol. You spend the night in a yurt on the high lakeshore.
meals: Lunch at guesthouse, dinner at yurt

title: Ride at Song-Kol, drive to Ysyk-Kol
desc: A gentle morning ride takes you along the shore of Song-Kol, past yurts and grazing herds, with the option to head up into the nearby hills if you'd like more time on horseback.
After lunch you leave the lake and drive toward Ysyk-Kol, perhaps stopping at the Ak-Say canyons on the way, before settling into a guesthouse near Bokonbaev for the night.
meals: Breakfast & lunch at yurt, dinner at guesthouse

title: South shore: eagle hunter, canyons & Jety-Oguz
desc: The day opens with an eagle-hunter demonstration by a local Kyrgyz hunter, a chance to see a tradition that's been passed down for generations. From there you explore the colour-streaked Fairy-Tale Canyons.
Lunch is at Lyubov Danichkina's home in Tamga Village, then you take in the Barskoon Waterfalls and the red sandstone of the Jety-Oguz Valley before arriving in Karakol for the night.
meals: Breakfast & lunch at guesthouse, dinner at restaurant

title: Off-road to Altyn-Arashan
desc: This morning you climb into the mountains aboard a rugged Soviet UAZ truck, following a sparkling river through dense pine forest up to the Altyn-Arashan gorge, a bumpy, beautiful ride.
After lunch the afternoon is yours: soak in the natural hot springs, wander the trails, or simply sit and take in Peak Palatka rising to 5200 m at the head of the valley.
meals: Breakfast at hotel, lunch & dinner at guesthouse

title: Drive back to Bishkek
desc: After a slow mountain morning, the UAZ carries you back down to Karakol for lunch at a local restaurant.
From there the road runs along the northern shore of Ysyk-Kol, the Pearl of Central Asia, with long lake views the whole way to Bishkek, where you arrive in the evening.
meals: Breakfast at hotel, lunch at restaurant
